A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the leptonic CP phases are suppressed in the absence of L–R symmetry, and the suppression is not lifted even in the presence of L–R, if the phase factorization holds.

the leptonic CP phases are strongly constrained and can only be enhanced in the presence of the L–R symmetry.
